resources.string: Welcome to “TAMYR”! Our app will help you monitor your heart health using data from wearable devices and surveys. We offer a smart and adaptive approach to health, predicting risks in time and improving your quality of life.

This Privacy Policy describes how TAMYR APP (“we”, “our”, or “us”) collects, uses, stores, and protects the personal and health-related data of users who install and use our mobile application. We are committed to ensuring that your privacy is protected and that your data is handled responsibly in accordance with applicable data protection laws.
 1. Information We Collect
 We may collect and process the following types of personal and sensitive information:
 1.1 Personal Identification Information
 Full name
 Email address
 Date of birth
 Gender
 1.2 Health and Lifestyle Information
 Data collected from wearable devices (e.g. Mi Band), including:
 Heart rate
 Step count
 Calories burned
 Sleep duration
 Responses to health-related questionnaires
 Lifestyle factors such as smoking, alcohol consumption, stress level
 1.3 Technical Data
 Device information (e.g., device model, operating system)
 IP address and time zone
 Usage data within the application
 2. How We Use Your Data
 We collect and use your data solely for the following purposes:
 To provide personalized health insights and risk predictions based on AI algorithms
 To enhance your user experience within the application
 To improve the performance and accuracy of our predictive models
 To fulfill legal and regulatory obligations related to health data management
 To provide technical support and resolve user-reported issues
 3. Legal Basis for Processing
 We process your personal data based on:
 Consent – by agreeing to this policy, you provide us with permission to process your data;
 Legitimate interest – improving and maintaining our services;
 Compliance with legal obligations – when required by applicable laws or regulations.
 4. Data Retention and Storage
 Your data is securely stored on encrypted servers and is retained only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy.
 You may request the deletion of your data at any time by contacting us.
 5. Data Sharing and Disclosure
 We do not sell, lease, or disclose your personal information to third parties except:
 When required by law or court order;
 When data is anonymized and used for academic or scientific research;
 When collaborating with medical institutions under strict confidentiality agreements (B2B partnerships).
 6. Your Rights as a Data Subject
 In accordance with data protection laws, you have the following rights:
 Right to access your personal data
 Right to correct inaccurate or outdated information
 Right to request deletion (“right to be forgotten”)
 Right to withdraw consent at any time
 Right to data portability
 To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at support@tamyrapp.kz
 7. Data Security
 We implement industry-standard security practices, including:
 Data encryption (both in transit and at rest)
 JWT-based authentication and token management
 Secure storage of access and refresh tokens
 Periodic audits and vulnerability assessments
 We continuously monitor and update our systems to protect against unauthorized access, misuse, loss, or disclosure.
 8. Children’s Privacy
 TAMYR APP is not intended for use by individuals under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect data from minors without parental consent.
 9. Updates to This Policy
 We reserve the right to amend this Privacy Policy at any time. All changes will be posted within the application and/or website, and the date of the latest revision will be indicated above. Your continued use of the application constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
 10. Contact Information
 If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or your data, please contact us:
 Email: support_tamyrapp@gmail.com
